label: Complete inclusive coverage exceeds a recipient exactly when it misses a pure perfection
paraphrase: Closed conditional test of an independently specified coverage order. In one existing inclusive formal-or-virtual ActFrame with a supplied Pure classification, if c covers every pure perfection, every x has content included in c's. With explicit excluded middle, strict set inclusion is equivalent to some pure perfection not inclusively possessed by x; equality is equivalent to complete recipient coverage. It asserts no actual complete source, limited recipient, missing perfection, intensity comparison or MoreIn calibration. It tests the strictness/application burden of a candidate for fd2c8710 and9eaa3b6e, not a metaphysical defeat or a new definition of esse fullness.
